name: osmo
description: OsmO Phone Calls for Grok Build: OsmO's AI makes real phone calls for you to shops, clinics, restaurants and helplines in the US, Canada, UK and Australia (up to 5 numbers at once), gets through phone menus, and brings back the answer with a summary, transcript and recording link. Schedule calls in your own time zone; after a call, OsmO offers to call again or schedule it with the same words. It is also your AI phone receptionist: see who called, pause the AI, choose who is put through, edit VIP and block lists and caller rules, switch the assistant's language, and read bookings. 50 free credits call businesses and toll-free numbers; calling your contacts, call-backs, scheduling and the receptionist need an OsmO app plan. Sign in with your phone number on first connect; no API key.
